limitations: Retrospectively rebuilt expected-goal values; not an untouched end-to-end holdout.

advanced.summary: Recency-weighted goals and expected goals, five-on-five and special teams, projected/confirmed goalies, and schedule rest. Injured goalies are removed from current starting options. Other skater absences are reported without an unvalidated numerical penalty.

validation.summary: Retrospective 2025–26 evaluation: Brier 0.2451 versus 0.2507 for the previous Sweater model. Advanced historical xG can be retrospectively revised; forward validation is ongoing. Playoff calibration is not established.
